components_strategy.hero_section: Outcome-driven, extreme simplicity. 'TeamNest.ai is currently invite-only.' Single primary CTA 'Request Invite' opening a modal, or secondary 'Enter Invite Code'. Hide standard nav links to force conversion.
components_strategy.waitlist_form: Segmented Beta style. Multi-step or dense Shadcn Form asking for Name, Email, Company, Role, Size, Use Case, 'What would you build?'. Use glassmorphism card.
components_strategy.waitlist_dashboard: The 'Skip-the-Line' Referral Loop. Shows massive typography for rank ('You are #1,247' using JetBrains Mono). Referral link with copy to clipboard. Progress bar for 1/3/5/10/25 referrals milestone rewards.
components_strategy.invite_code_entry: Minimalist Code Entry Card. 8-character input (1 char per box or single monospace input). States: valid (glows green/amber), invalid (shakes, red), expired.
components_strategy.invite_dashboard_approved: Dashboard for approved users showing 4 available invites, share buttons (copy/WhatsApp/X/LinkedIn/email/SMS), and a list of accepted/pending invites.
components_strategy.social_drop_page: High-urgency countdown page for /drop/DEVOS100. Shows remaining uses '17 of 100 spots remaining' with a dynamic progress bar. Big 'Claim Access' CTA.
components_strategy.referral_leaderboard: List of top inviters with avatars, masked names (e.g., Al***), and invite count. Gamifies the experience.
components_strategy.badges: Visual 'Founding Member', 'Early Builder', 'Dev OS Beta Tester', 'Invite Champion' badges locked until criteria met. Premium gold foil aesthetics using CSS gradients.
components_strategy.pricing_gated: Frosted glass overlay covering pricing tiers with a lock icon. 'Pricing is currently available to invited members only.'

motion_and_interactions.page_load: Subtle fade up and blur reveal (framer-motion).
motion_and_interactions.number_counters: Animate waitlist rank and referral count numbers counting up.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and borders glow with amber-400/20.
motion_and_interactions.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for success/error states (e.g., 'Invite code copied!', 'Code expired').

hero_background.description: Intricate golden wave patterns on dark background. Use with absolute positioning, opacity-20, and a radial-gradient mask to fade out edges so text remains fully legible.

dev_manager_context.description: Code screen snippet to visually represent @devmanager in feature grids or alongside the waitlist form. Apply rounded-2xl and a subtle border-zinc-800.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: NOTE: Codebase uses .js (JSX) files, NOT .tsx. Provide all React code using vanilla JS syntax (no TypeScript interfaces or types).
Install required fonts: Cabinet Grotesk, Satoshi, JetBrains Mono.
Install icon library: lucide-react (or @phosphor-icons/react for duotone).
Hide the global navigation links for the launch landing pages to remove distractions. Only show the Logo and a 'Request Invite' button.
Build the hero section with a centered, outcome-driven layout. Background should use the provided golden wave texture with extremely low opacity (10-20%) and a radial mask to prevent text collision.
For the Waitlist Dashboard (post-signup), implement the 'Skip-the-line' mechanism. Show the user's rank prominently. Add a referral progress bar with markers for 1, 3, 5, 10, 25 referrals.
Design the code entry card to feel like accessing a secure vault. Use mono fonts for the code characters.
Ensure all text has a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 against the dark zinc background.
Use Shadcn components for forms, inputs, and buttons, but aggressively strip the 'default Vercel look'. Overwrite borders to border-zinc-800 and backgrounds to bg-zinc-950/50.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements as specified in the testing_attributes section.
